ops.text: `golangci-lint run` inside a git worktree of cc-context reported 4 phantom gosec G204 findings whose paths pointed at the *primary* checkout (`../../../../Code/cc-context/internal/render/render.go` etc.) — files identical to HEAD in my worktree and unmodified by my change. The giveaway was that the printed source line didn't match the diagnostic (a comment line reported as "Subprocess launched with variable"), because the other checkout had drifted with a concurrent session's uncommitted edits. Both worktrees share `~/Library/Caches/go-build` under the same module path, so the stale analysis was served from cache; scoping the run to `./internal/render/...` did not help. `golangci-lint cache clean` then `task lint` → 0 issues. Worth knowing before anyone treats a cross-worktree lint finding as real.
